change_summary: Joined OnClickMedia historical options structure rows to existing Ginger candidate days across the three canonical windows as a shadow-only overlay.

delta_metrics.reason: Shadow-only overlay did not alter signal generation, candidate ranking, sizing, exits, or orders.

gate4.reason: No production strategy rule was changed; shadow overlay was not stable enough to justify promotion.

historical_experiment_check.why_not_simple_repeat: This run used new local OnClickMedia chain rows from exp-20260506-003 instead of repeating the previous no-options-data audits.

hypothesis: EOD options structure may add overlay information to existing Ginger candidate days: call OI structure could identify better continuation candidates, while put-skew/downside structure could identify weaker candidates.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy tape where strategy profits but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed older tape with lower win rate

mechanism_insight: The OnClickMedia options overlay has high historical candidate coverage, but naive call-structure support was not bullish on aggregate and downside-risk structure was directionally negative only in two of three windows. Historical rows remain PIT-unsafe, so this is not production-promotable alpha.
next_retry_requires: Forward PIT-safe OnClickMedia rows with closed outcomes
A richer options feature set such as IV rank, IV-vs-realized, earnings IV flag, and vendor-asof metadata
A replay that proves options tags improve same-day slot replacement value in most windows

parameters.call_structure_support: liquid rows >= 10, call OI > put OI, and max call OI concentration >= 12%
parameters.downside_structure_risk: liquid rows >= 10 and either put/call OI >= 1.25 or approx 25-delta skew >= 0.05

rejection_reason: No production EV changed; shadow call-support underperformed aggregate candidates and downside-risk tags were unstable across windows while the source lacks historical vendor-asof metadata.
